plugins.name: organic-to-paid

plugins.name: creative-led-growth

plugins.name: creator-programs
plugins.description: Design, run and audit a creator program paid on performance.

plugins.name: x-launch-playbook
plugins.description: Plan a launch week on X judged on business numbers.
